posts.author: bijo_scaria
posts.text: SAMHI Hotels has passed a resolution to raise up to ₹750 crore , but this should not necessarily be interpreted as an immediate need for funds. My understanding is that the company wants to keep this as a strategic funding option or contingency buffer , which can be utilised if a good acquisition, expansion opportunity or unforeseen requirement arises. The actual utilisation will depend on the company’s future capital requirements and the terms at which the funds are raised. My bet on SAMHI is the next 5 years. posts.author: Aiyappaa
posts.text: I agree. Management has not explicitly mentioned that the cash will be used to reduce debt. However, until the fund is deployed toward acquiring the distressed asset, the cash will remain within the business, which could potentially help reduce the debt burden or support better pricing on interest rates.
